verdict.rationale: Superset lets users drive it in natural language through agents. The prompt-first flow turns a described task into a running agent session. The `superset:orchestrate` skill lets one agent coordinate workers in separate workspaces from a plain-English request ("split this migration into independent slices and run a worker on each"). The live hosted MCP server lets an MCP-capable agent create workspaces, launch agents, schedule automations, open terminals and manage tasks on the user's behalf. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface for operating the app itself (all NL control runs through external coding agents, and one user describes it as terminal-centric rather than chat-centric), and independent hands-on corroboration of NL-driven orchestration.
